chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Train to New York; the Streets of Paris owner
summary: They traveled to New York by train in compartments; the owner heard Tatum jamming for free and told the trio to play there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: ...First thing I know we were in New York,...
How did you travel to New York?
Train... We had compartments, ... We all came together...
So you got to know 'em pretty well?
Yep, yep, that's a between yep cause I could never hang out with him I mean,
You mentioned the owner of the Street of Paris, do you remember much about him?

...I never got to know him too good... He recognized the music. Some how he heard we were over there playing, especially Fatum his man that was working for him playing over there, he say "What the hell he doin' over there playin' every night for free". And the trio was gotten formed at the time & we didn't know we were just havin' fun. Till finally one night Fatum told us, he said "Look, we're gonna play out here" I don't know what the words were,....
...The other thing we had over there wasn't much when I took Slim's place...
